title: The demo as it opens
caption: The form as the demo opens: a synthetic Swiss referral in formancy's React renderer, filled with the sample's answers. “Change an answer, and the resources are made again from what you entered.” ([0012](./docs/decisions/0012-a-demo-at-formancy-ai-health-fills-a-synthetic-referral-in-the-browser-served-by-a-worker-of-its-own.md))
alt: The demo's form section: the form on a white card on a dark page, with the question for the specialist, “Synthetische Fragestellung, ohne klinische Bedeutung”, the specialty Dermatology, the patient's language Français, an interpreter needed for Französisch, an appointment date and a practice phone of zeros, the To the resources button, and under the card the line saying the answers are the sample's.

title: An answer changed
caption: The demo's synthetic Swiss referral with the question for the specialist changed to “Geänderte synthetische Fragestellung”: the browser has made the QuestionnaireResponse again from the answers, as FHIR R4 JSON claiming SDC's and CH ORF's profiles, with the new answer in it. Nothing has validated it: the page runs no validator ([0007](./docs/decisions/0007-a-formancy-submission-is-a-questionnaireresponse-of-the-same-mapping-refused-whole-where-an-answer-cannot-be-one.md), [0012](./docs/decisions/0012-a-demo-at-formancy-ai-health-fills-a-synthetic-referral-in-the-browser-served-by-a-worker-of-its-own.md)).
alt: The QuestionnaireResponse's section, made by health-questionnaire, with the top of its JSON shown, from its resourceType and its SDC and CH ORF profiles down to the changed question's answer.

title: A required answer cleared
caption: The question for the specialist cleared, though the form requires it. health-questionnaire refuses the whole response rather than leave the answer out, naming the item and never a value: “answers.question: its item is required, and a completed response holds no answer to it that R4 counts”. With no response there is no CH ORF document either: “Not made: the answers are refused, and a CH ORF document carries them.” ([0007](./docs/decisions/0007-a-formancy-submission-is-a-questionnaireresponse-of-the-same-mapping-refused-whole-where-an-answer-cannot-be-one.md))
alt: The QuestionnaireResponse's section saying health-questionnaire refused it, with the rule required and its message, and the CH ORF document's section saying it was not made.

title: Refused on purpose
caption: Fixed inputs, each broken in one way and run through the package that refuses it: a form in a spec version nothing here reads, a rule an SDC enableWhen cannot say, an AHV number and a GLN whose check digits are wrong, which the HL7 FHIR validator only warns of, and a letter declared PDF/A that no gate has proved. Each refusal names where, never the value: “context.patient.ahvn13: its check digit is not the one its identifier system computes from its other digits” ([0006](./docs/decisions/0006-a-formancy-form-is-an-sdc-questionnaire-refused-whole-where-it-cannot-be-one.md), [0009](./docs/decisions/0009-a-ch-orf-document-is-the-hosts-referral-in-ch-core-and-ch-orf-the-questionnaire-by-canonical-and-swiss-identifiers-checked-here.md), [0008](./docs/decisions/0008-a-document-is-a-bundle-of-what-it-refers-to-and-a-pdf-its-own-bytes-never-an-unproved-pdf-a.md)).
alt: Five cases in a grid of three columns, the last cell empty, each saying what is broken and the refusal its package states: the form's spec version, a rule the mapping cannot say, the patient's AHV number, the practitioner's GLN and the letter's PDF/A declaration.

title: The Questionnaire read out
caption: The Questionnaire health-questionnaire made of the form, the corpus's own: “Made by @formancy/health-questionnaire. It is the corpus entry questionnaire-demo-referral.json, byte for byte.” It is read out of its JSON, never of the form: each item with its linkId, its type, whether it is required or repeats, its options, when it is shown, and a way to its field where formancy's renderer draws one control of it to lead to, which it does not for a radio group such as the patient's language. Its title is in German alone, as the form gives it, and the read-out says so: “Zuweisung (not translated into English in the Questionnaire: its own text, in de-CH)” ([0013](./docs/decisions/0013-the-demo-reads-its-questionnaire-out-from-the-bytes-it-shows-and-renders-no-questionnaire.md)).
alt: The Questionnaire's section: made by health-questionnaire, the corpus entry; the read-out's heading and what it reads; the title Zuweisung; and the seven items, each with its linkId, type, required and repeats, the specialty's and the language's options, the condition under which the language to interpret is shown, and a button to the field under every item but the patient's language.
